instruction: Expanded Two-Story Visual Office From Init Model This task starts from Desktop input file: init.osm. Reference image is provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png. Modify the OpenStudio model as needed and save the required output as result.osm. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 2 OS:BuildingStory objects, 10 OS:Space objects, and 10 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly V11-F1-North, V11-F1-South, V11-F1-West, V11-F1-East, V11-F1-Core, V11-F2-North, V11-F2-South, V11-F2-West, V11-F2-East, and V11-F2-Core. 5. Every OS:Space references an OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 68 OS:Surface objects: 10 Floor surfaces, 10 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 48 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 5 Ground, 21 Outdoors, and 42 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 16 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 16. 9. The model contains exactly 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 10 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 28.00 m, Y span 20.00 m, and Z span 8.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 1120.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 768.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 245.76 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
